gloss: several houses; a few buildings; several establishments

definitions.gloss: several houses; a few buildings; several establishments
definitions.explanation: A small, indefinite number of houses, shops, or other buildings, typically three to five or so.

examples.japanese: {数軒|すうけん}の{店|みせ}を{回|まわ}った。
この{通|とお}りには{数軒|すうけん}のレストランがある。
examples.english: There are several restaurants on this street.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}の{影響|えいきょう}で、{数軒|すうけん}の{家|いえ}が{浸水|しんすい}{被害|ひがい}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: Due to the typhoon, several houses suffered flood damage.

notes:
A compound of {数|すう} (several/a few) and {軒|けん} (counter for houses and buildings). The prefix {数|すう} is a productive way to express an approximate small quantity with any counter: {数人|すうにん} (several people), {数回|すうかい} (several times), {数日|すうじつ} (several days).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数軒|すうけん}の{家|いえ}: several houses
- {数軒|すうけん}{先|さき}: a few doors down
- {数軒|すうけん}{隣|となり}: a few houses away

OTHER {数|すう}+ COUNTER WORDS:
- {数人|すうにん}: several people
- {数回|すうかい}: several times
- {数日|すうじつ}: several days
- {数冊|すうさつ}: several books
- {数枚|すうまい}: several flat objects (sheets, plates, etc.)
